description.value:
Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Shield Block].

As your shield blocks an assault, you create a flash of brilliant, multicolored light in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:spell] save against your spell DC, with the following effects.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end this blinded condition.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.
